title: Diff-scoped review of the usage-adapter fix (cumulative tokens, status precedence)
summary: Fresh-session diff-scoped verification of one fix commit in the kit's dispatch adapter answering an external report: prove multi-turn envelope usage is reported as cumulative information with no ratio and single-turn usage keeps its ratio, that HIGH_USAGE is asserted only from a final-context measurement, that gates decide status and a continuation status requires an artifact, that the prompt names the working directory, that cost never becomes spend, and that the cap marker never lowers max_cycles; verify frozen launch texts, surface and fixture hygiene. Report-only.
